product_metadata.title: SOPAT Extra Thick Mattress Topper King 400TC Cotton Pillow Top Breathable Mattress Pad Protector with 8-22" Deep Pocket Soft Down Alternative Fill Mattress Cover (78x80 Inches, White)
features: 👍👍👍【Top Comfort & Optimum Thickness】With the Cloud-like Surface, made of 400TC Cotton, gives superior comfort without extra heat and sweat. Adopting the newly developed "Double Border Pillow Top Construction" technology, stuffed with 50% more filling than other pads on the market. Compared to the normal mattress topper, this one with new shape is more supportive and soft.

👍👍👍【Soft & Breathable】Filled with 4D snow down alternative fill, a state-of-the-art fiberfill that has the feel of authentic goose and down without the feathers and poking. Also it can protect your mattress from stains and offers sweet nights.

👍👍👍【Get Healthier and More Quality Sleep】The 400 Thread Count Cotton topper provides enough support and prevents back ache. With the Skin-friendly cotton cover , the spilled fluid can also be wiped quickly. And due to its thickness, the fluid will not soak the mattress if it’s less than 200ml. Feel free to enjoy your breakfast on bed.

👍👍👍【21 Inches Deep Pockets & Fit Perfectly】 The pad is equipped with an all-around elastic skirt for a perfect tight fit on your mattress. The soft fabric sides easily stretch to fit mattresses up to 21 inches thick. It will never slide no matter how you twist and turn in your bed. Great gifts for men and women, Moms and Dads, Valentine's - Mother's - Father's Day - Thanksgiving and Christmas.

👍👍👍【Machine Washable & Customer Support】Mattress Topper is machine washable. Easy to keep it clean. Since the product comes in a vacuum bag, we advice to tumble dry the mattress topper on low heat to let air fluff it up. Please feel free to contact us about how to fluff it and any other issues. We will certainly do our best to provide the best after-sales service.
